title: Momoi Airi — A Song Of Courage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks for gathering on such short notice, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm always happy to have lunch with you, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's unfortunate Ichika isn't able to join us today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's got broadcasting committee stuff. Our hands are tied.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll explain why I asked you all to gather while we eat.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Kusanagi has apparently been asked to lead the planning committee's stage performance for Shibu Schools Fest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's going to be a musical, and she needs a lot of people to help make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see. I had a feeling that's what this was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The truth is, Ichi's already told us a little about what's happening!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Apparently, Kusanagi asked her if she'd like to help with this musical, too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've actually been talking about how fun it could be to work on it, since so many schools are going to be participating.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I really had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure Kusanagi would really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but... I'm sure things are really busy for Leo/need right now, with your debut song becoming a big hit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, things are busy, and we have quite a lot on our plate at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the record company did give us permission to participate, since they view this festival as an official school event.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, we plan to enjoy being 100% high schoolers, at least while we're helping with Shibu Schools Fest♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's nice to hear that their record company is letting them enjoy their school life like this.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, can I pencil you all in to help with the musical?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes♪
Yes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Including Ichika, the four of us will be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, have you already spoken to Shizuku about this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The festival itself came up during dinner last night, but nothing about this musical.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I asked her to join us here today, but she had to take care of some committee business.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I'll just tell her later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're sorta free right now, so I'm pretty sure she'll also want to join in on the fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Why don't you and Shizuku join the same team, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Why would we do that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Didn't you ask Airi if she'd already told Shizuku because you want to work with her?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's not what I meant. I was just worried that she'd come up to me later and say, “Why didn't you tell me?” while using her puppy-dog eyes on me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, what about Hanasato and Kiritani...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I do plan on bringing it up to them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, they're scheduled to work during the period when we'll be preparing for the festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I wish they could join us, but they've been working towards this offer for a long time now. Having them reschedule is basically impossible at this point.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was so looking forward to enjoying this festival with them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But the best part about Shibu Schools Fest is the fact that we'll get to work with students from all the other schools.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Kusanagi's participating, which means we should get to see a bunch of other familiar faces from Kamiyama High, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, Tsukasa also talked to me about this festival!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean Toya's also going to participate?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shiraishi also seems to like these kinds of events, so I'm sure she and Kohane will be participating as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about Mizuki and Ena?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ena? She might if a friend invites her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This also seems like Mizuki's cup of tea. Even more so if Akito and the others are all gonna be participating.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Cool! That means we'll all get to work on this musical together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly! We might even get to make some new friends.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Opportunities like this don't come up often, so let's do our best to give our leader, Kusanagi, the support she deserves!

rows.Speaker: Shiho, Honami & Saki
rows.Line: Right!
